examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 警察的工作主要是保護民眾，讓好人不被傷害。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá de gōngzuò zhǔyào shì bǎohù mínzhòng, ràng hǎorén bù bèi shānghài.
examples.english: The police's job is mainly to protect the public, so that good people are not hurt.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 大龍最近買了一套音響，每天回到家就聽他最愛的英國樂團的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Dàlóng zuìjìn mǎi le yī tào yīnxiǎng, měitiān huí dào jiā jiù tīng tā zuì ài de Yīngguó yuètuán de yīnyuè.
examples.english: Dalong recently bought a stereo set; every day when he gets home, he listens to music by his favorite British band.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 在王小姐的部落格裡，除了有她的旅遊日記，還有在非洲大草原騎馬的相片。
examples.pinyin: Zài Wáng xiǎojiě de bùluògé lǐ, chúle yǒu tā de lǚyóu rìjì, hái yǒu zài Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán qí mǎ de xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: In Miss Wang's blog, besides her travel diary, there are also photos of horseback riding on the African savanna.

examples.chinese: 臭豆腐是臺灣有名的小吃，不過味道很獨特，不是每個人都能接受。
examples.pinyin: Chòu dòufu shì Táiwān yǒumíng de xiǎochī, búguò wèidào hěn dútè, bú shì měi ge rén dōu néng jiēshòu.
examples.english: Stinky tofu is a famous snack in Taiwan, but its flavor is very unique; not everyone can accept it.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 小張對世界地理和歷史相當有興趣，為了打開視野，他決定花一年的時間出國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng duì shìjiè dìlǐ hé lìshǐ xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, wèile dǎkāi shìyě, tā juédìng huā yì nián de shíjiān chūguó lǚxíng.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is quite interested in world geography and history. In order to broaden his vision, he decided to spend a year traveling abroad.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 要是你想知道山區天氣的情況，上網看看氣象預報就行了。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng zhīdào shānqū tiānqì de qíngkuàng, shàngwǎng kànkan qìxiàng yùbào jiù xíng le.
examples.english: If you want to know the weather conditions in the mountains, just go online and check the weather forecast.

examples.chinese: 小李進公司的頭三個月，每天上班要花兩個小時，後來搬到公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jìn gōngsī de tóu sān ge yuè, měi tiān shàngbān yào huā liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hòulái bān dào gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: For the first three months after Xiao Li joined the company, it took him two hours to commute every day; later he moved near the company, and it took only ten minutes to walk there.

examples.chinese: 天空突然下起了大雨，我的衣服和頭髮都濕了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ de yīfu hé tóufa dōu shī le.
examples.english: Suddenly it started raining heavily, and my clothes and hair all got wet.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的變化很大，不少老房屋已經變成新大樓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà, bùshǎo lǎo fángwū yǐjīng biànchéng xīn dàlóu le.
examples.english: This city has changed a lot; many old houses have already turned into new high-rise buildings.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 何小姐地個性溫柔，笑起來也很迷人，所以追求她的人很多。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě de gèxìng wēnróu, xiào qǐlái yě hěn mírén, suǒyǐ zhuīqiú tā de rén hěn duō.
examples.english: Miss He has a gentle personality and her smile is very charming, so many people pursue her.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的地形有三分之一是平原，三分之二是高山。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de dìxíng yǒu sān fēn zhī yī shì píngyuán, sān fēn zhī èr shì gāoshān.
examples.english: One third of the landscape in this area is plains, and two thirds are high mountains.

examples.chinese: 王小姐失戀後，花了三年時間才把那個男的忘掉。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě shīliàn hòu, huā le sān nián shíjiān cái bǎ nàge nán de wàngdiào.
examples.english: After Ms. Wang was crossed in love, it took her three years to forget that man.

examples.chinese: 為了偏僻地區孩子的教育，有十幾位老師願意上山下海，到山上、海邊的學校教書。
examples.pinyin: Wèile piānpì dìqū háizi de jiàoyù, yǒu shí jǐ wèi lǎoshī yuànyì shàngshānxiàhǎi, dào shānshàng, hǎibiān de xuéxiào jiāoshū.
examples.english: For the education of children in remote areas, more than ten teachers are willing to go everywhere, to schools in the mountains and by the sea, to teach.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 臺灣曾經是日本的殖民地，被日本殖民過五十年。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān céngjīng shì Rìběn de zhímíndì, bèi Rìběn zhímín guò wǔshí nián.
examples.english: Taiwan was once a colony of Japan and was colonized by Japan for fifty years.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 就我對小林的了解，他是一個很實在的人，不但做事認真，說話也不誇張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù wǒ duì Xiǎo Lín de liǎojiě, tā shì yīgè hěn shízài de rén, bùdàn zuòshì rènzhēn, shuōhuà yě bù kuāzhāng.
examples.english: With regard to my understanding of Xiao Lin, he is a very honest person; not only does he work seriously, but he also doesn't exaggerate when he speaks.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 何先生的肩膀比較寬，這件襯衫他穿起來太緊了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng de jiānbǎng bǐjiào kuān, zhè jiàn chènshān tā chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le.
examples.english: Mr. He's shoulders are rather wide; this shirt is too tight when he puts it on.

examples.chinese: 臺北美術館最近舉辦了很有名的畫展，吸引了很多民眾去欣賞那些畫。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Měishùguǎn zuìjìn jǔbàn le hěn yǒumíng de huàzhǎn, xīyǐn le hěn duō mínzhòng qù xīnshǎng nàxiē huà.
examples.english: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum recently held a very famous painting exhibition, attracting many people to go appreciate those paintings.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 我到德國留學的頭兩個星期，因為對環境不環境而迷過幾次路，後來就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào Déguó liúxué de tóu liǎng gè xīngqī, yīnwèi duì huánjìng bù shúxī ér mí guò jǐ cì lù, hòulái jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: In the first two weeks of studying in Germany, because I was not familiar with the environment, I got lost a few times; later there was no problem.

examples.chinese: 張先生的個性很活潑、說話很幽默，跟他聊天總是很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn huópō, shuōhuà hěn yōumò, gēn tā liáotiān zǒngshì hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's personality is very lively and his speech is very humorous; chatting with him is always very pleasant.

examples.chinese: 五年前經驗過護照被偷的意外後，每次出國我都把護照放在上衣裡面的口袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ nián qián jīngyàn guò hùzhào bèi tōu de yìwài hòu, měi cì chūguó wǒ dōu bǎ hùzhào fàng zài shàngyī lǐmiàn de kǒudài.
examples.english: After experiencing the accident of having my passport stolen five years ago, every time I go abroad, I put my passport in the pocket inside my jacket.

examples.chinese: 還好你告訴我今天黃教授的課停課一次，要不然我就白跑一趟了。
examples.pinyin: Háihǎo nǐ gàosu wǒ jīntiān Huáng jiàoshòu de kè tíngkè yī cì, yàobùrán wǒ jiù bái pǎo yī tàng le.
examples.english: Good thing you told me that Professor Huang's class is canceled today; otherwise, I would have made a trip in vain.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 東西方的文化差異很大，像穿著、音樂、哲學等風格都不相同。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì hěn dà, xiàng chuānzhuó, yīnyuè, zhéxué děng fēnggé dōu bù xiāngtóng.
examples.english: The cultural differences between East and West are great; styles such as apparel, music, and philosophy are all different.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，孔子是地位最高、最偉大的老師，他的思想影響了很多人。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, Kǒngzǐ shì dìwèi zuì gāo, zuì wěidà de lǎoshī, tā de sīxiǎng yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén.
examples.english: For Chinese people, Confucius is the teacher with the highest position and the greatest, and his thoughts have influenced many people.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 我往東走，你往西走，我們兩個的方向剛好相反。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng dōng zǒu, nǐ wǎng xī zǒu, wǒmen liǎng gè de fāngxiàng gānghǎo xiāngfǎn.
examples.english: I walk east, you walk west; our two directions are exactly opposite.

examples.chinese: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng de guānxì, Xià xiǎojiě yǐjīng yǒu yī duàn shíjiān méi shàngjiē gòuwù le.
examples.english: Because she is too busy with work, Miss Xia has not gone out shopping for some time.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 參加籃球社的條件是跑步的速度得夠快，但是沒有身高的限制。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lánqiú shè de tiáojiàn shì pǎobù de sùdù děi gòu kuài, dànshì méiyǒu shēngāo de xiànzhì.
examples.english: The condition for joining the basketball club is that your running speed must be fast enough, but there is no height restriction.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 我今天跟同學穿了樣式不同，但是顏色相同的洋裝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān gēn tóngxué chuān le yàngshì bùtóng, dànshì yánsè xiāngtóng de yángzhuāng.
examples.english: Today my classmate and I wore dresses that are different in style but the same in color.

examples.chinese: 對爺爺來說，所謂的「好孩子」，就是很孝順、有禮貌、功課好的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Duì yéye lái shuō, suǒwèi de "hǎo háizi", jiùshì hěn xiàoshùn, yǒu lǐmào, gōngkè hǎo de háizi.
examples.english: To Grandpa, a so-called "good child" is a child who is very filial, polite, and does well in school.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén rènwéi tóutòng shì xiǎoshì, kuàngqiě zuìjìn máng de lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu bù gòu, suǒyǐ bù kěn qù kànbìng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Chén thinks a headache is a small matter; furthermore, recently he has been so busy that he doesn't even have enough time to rest, so he refuses to see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.
examples.english: After all, he is a child and doesn't yet understand the principles of how to conduct himself and do things; when he grows up, he will understand.

examples.chinese: 這家超市賣的商品都是安全的，讓顧客買得安心、吃得安心，用的也安心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì mài de shāngpǐn dōu shì ānquán de, ràng gùkè mǎi de ānxīn, chī de ānxīn, yòng de yě ānxīn.
examples.english: The products sold at this supermarket are all safe, allowing customers to buy with peace of mind, eat with peace of mind, and use with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le. Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english: My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m. Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 今天的數學考試我只考了三十分，要是被爸爸知道，他一定會罵我的。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de shùxué kǎoshì wǒ zhǐ kǎo le sānshí fēn, yàoshi bèi bàba zhīdào, tā yídìng huì mà wǒ de.
examples.english: I only scored 30 on today’s math test; if my dad finds out, he will definitely scold me.

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidù hěn chà, érqiě yí bù gāoxìng jiù mà rén, shéi shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng rén a!
examples.english: His attitude toward work is very bad, and whenever he is unhappy he scolds people; who can tolerate this kind of person!

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 如果你想了解臺灣社會的人、事、物，最好親自來臺灣住一段時間。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě Táiwān shèhuì de rén, shì, wù, zuìhǎo qīnzì lái Táiwān zhù yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: If you want to understand the people, events, and things of Taiwanese society, it is best to come to Taiwan yourself and stay for a period of time.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 我同學記筆記的速度很快，也記得很清楚，所以我常跟他借筆記來複習功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué jì bǐjì de sùdù hěn kuài, yě jì de hěn qīngchu, suǒyǐ wǒ cháng gēn tā jiè bǐjì lái fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: My classmate takes notes very quickly and also remembers them very clearly, so I often borrow his notes to review my lessons.

examples.chinese: 我的漢字考試總是不及格，經過三個月努力地練習，終於及格了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànzì kǎoshì zǒngshì bù jígé, jīngguò sān ge yuè nǔlì de liànxí, zhōngyú jígé le.
examples.english: I always fail my Chinese character exams; after three months of hard practice, I finally passed.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 這個學期中文課的新教材是時代華語第三冊，一共有十六課。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī Zhōngwén kè de xīn jiàocái shì Shídài Huáyǔ dì-sān cè, yígòng yǒu shíliù kè.
examples.english: This semester’s new Chinese course teaching material is Modern Chinese Volume 3, which has sixteen lessons in total.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

examples.chinese: 這堂語法課的內容比較難，學生有任何問題都可以舉手請教老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng yǔfǎ kè de nèiróng bǐjiào nán, xuéshēng yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī.
examples.english: The content of this grammar class is relatively difficult; students can raise their hands to ask the teacher for advice if they have any questions.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 這個手錶你已經戴了快二十年了吧？他對你有甚麼特殊的意義呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒubiǎo nǐ yǐjīng dài le kuài èrshí nián le ba? Tā duì nǐ yǒu shénme tèshū de yìyì ne?
examples.english: You have already worn this watch for almost twenty years, right? Does it have any special meaning to you?

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xiǎngfǎ hěn bù shíjì, tā yīzhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō, shì shǎo, lí jiā jìn de gōngzuò, dàn zhè zhǒng gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo a!
examples.english: My older brother's way of thinking is very impractical; he keeps wanting to find a job with lots of money, little work, and close to home, but that kind of job is hard to find!

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 父母是我最親愛的家人，誰都不能代替他們在我心中的地位。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì wǒ zuì qīn'ài de jiārén, shéi dōu bù néng dàitì tāmen zài wǒ xīnzhōng de dìwèi.
examples.english: My parents are my dearest family members; no one can replace their place in my heart.

examples.chinese: 我們把考卷交給老師後，老師就把正確的答案告訴大家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ kǎojuàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī hòu, lǎoshī jiù bǎ zhèngquè de dá'àn gàosu dàjiā.
examples.english: After we handed the exam papers to the teacher, the teacher then told everyone the correct answers.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: A:你知道辦理留學的手續需要準備哪些資料嗎？ B:我不清楚。你可以上網查查。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhīdào bànlǐ liúxué de shǒuxù xūyào zhǔnbèi nǎxiē zīliào ma? B: Wǒ bù qīngchu. Nǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng cháchá.
examples.english: A: Do you know what materials need to be prepared to deal with the procedures for studying abroad? B: I'm not sure. You can look it up online.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: 陳先生身體一向挺健康的，沒想到一個小感冒就讓他病了一個多月。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng shēntǐ yīxiàng tǐng jiànkāng de, méi xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎo gǎnmào jiù ràng tā bìng le yī gè duō yuè.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has always been quite healthy; I never expected that a small cold would make him fall ill for over a month.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 去朋友家以前，一定要約好時間才去，這是做人的基本禮貌。孔子認為對人有禮貌、尊敬老師、孝順父母，是做人的基本。
examples.pinyin: Qù péngyǒu jiā yǐqián, yīdìng yào yuēhǎo shíjiān cái qù, zhè shì zuòrén de jīběn lǐmào. Kǒngzǐ rènwéi duì rén yǒu lǐmào, zūnjìng lǎoshī, xiàoshùn fùmǔ, shì zuòrén de jīběn.
examples.english: Before going to a friend's house, you must set a time before going; this is basic courtesy in dealing with people. Confucius believed that being polite to others, respecting teachers, and being filial to parents are the basics of being a person.

examples.chinese: 佳佳認為談戀愛的對象，年齡不重要，容不容易溝通、個性適不適合才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiājiā rènwéi tán liàn'ài de duìxiàng, niánlíng bù zhòngyào, róng bù róngyì gōutōng, gèxìng shì bù shìhé cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Jiajia believes that for a romantic partner, age is not important; whether it is easy to communicate with them and whether their personality suits you are the most important things.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 報名衝浪課的手續很簡單，只要到辦公室填一張基本資料表就行了。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng chōnglàng kè de shǒuxù hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyào dào bàngōngshì tián yī zhāng jīběn zīliào biǎo jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The procedure for registering for the surfing class is very simple; you just need to go to the office and fill out one basic information form.

examples.chinese: 小藍從小在育幼院長大，最大的願望就是將來能有一個溫暖的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiānglái néng yǒu yī gè wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
examples.english: Xiao Lan grew up in an orphanage; her greatest wish is to have a warm family in the future.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

examples.chinese: 這部戲的男主角英俊、女主角漂亮，加上演員都演得很好，所以非常受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xì de nán zhǔjué yīngjùn, nǚ zhǔjué piàoliang, jiāshàng yǎnyuán dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The male lead in this drama is handsome and the female lead is pretty; moreover, all the actors act very well, so it is extremely popular.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 章先生念國小時，父親帶著他上山下海、到處旅遊，那是屬於他們的美好記憶。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng niàn guóxiǎo shí, fùqīn dàizhe tā shàngshān xiàhǎi, dàochù lǚyóu, nà shì shǔyú tāmen de měihǎo jìyì.
examples.english: When Mr. Zhang was in elementary school, his father took him up mountains and across seas, traveling everywhere; that is a beautiful memory belonging to them.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 正常的生活作息，對身體和心理健康都很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngcháng de shēnghuó zuòxī, duì shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ jiànkāng dōu hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: A normal daily schedule is very important for both physical and mental health.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī gàosu bìngrén, děi àn sāncān fànhòu de shíjiān chī yào, cái néng kuài diǎn huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The nurse told the patient that he must take medicine according to the times after the three meals in order to recover his health quickly.

examples.chinese: 醫生一再警告韓先生絕對不能再喝酒了，要不然他的身體情況就會更糟了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yízài jǐnggào Hán xiānsheng juéduì bù néng zài hējiǔ le, yàobùrán tā de shēntǐ qíngkuàng jiù huì gèng zāo le.
examples.english: The doctor repeatedly warned Mr. Han that he absolutely must not drink alcohol anymore; otherwise his physical condition would get worse.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 有人信上帝，有人不信。但在東西方的文化中，「上帝」的角色都是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xìn Shàngdì, yǒu rén bú xìn. Dàn zài dōng xīfāng de wénhuà zhōng, “Shàngdì” de juésè dōu shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Some people believe in God, and some do not. But in both Eastern and Western cultures, the role of “God” is very important.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: 出國當交換學生的目的，不僅僅是為了學習語言，更重要的是了解當地的文化。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó dāng jiāohuàn xuéshēng de mùdì, bù jǐnjǐn shì wèile xuéxí yǔyán, gèng zhòngyào de shì liǎojiě dāngdì de wénhuà.
examples.english: The purpose of going abroad as an exchange student is not merely to study a language; more importantly, it is to understand the local culture.

examples.chinese: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng zuìjìn yùdàole hěn búxìng de shì, tā de fùmǔ zài yì chǎng jiāotōng yìwài zhōng qùshì le.
examples.english: Mr. Jin recently encountered a very unfortunate event: his parents died in a traffic accident.

examples.chinese: 王小姐用網路交友的方式，找到了理想的結婚對象。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě yòng wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì, zhǎodàole lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng.
examples.english: Miss Wang used the method of making friends online and found her ideal marriage partner.

examples.chinese: 透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò jiàoshòu de jièshào, wǒ yī bìyè jiù shùnlì de zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Through the professor's introduction, I smoothly found a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎobǎn zuò shēngyì bù lǎoshí, yīzài gēn kèrén bǎozhèng shāngpǐn méi wèntí, qíshí shì piànrén de.
examples.english: That boss is not honest in doing business; he repeatedly assures customers that the products have no problems, but actually it's a scam.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese: 他是一個誠實的孩子，做錯事一定會勇敢承認的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge chéngshí de háizi, zuò cuò shì yīdìng huì yǒnggǎn chéngrèn de.
examples.english: He is an honest child; if he does something wrong, he will definitely bravely admit it.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 何老闆替公司建立了良好的制度，讓員工都能安心地工作。
examples.pinyin: Hé lǎobǎn tì gōngsī jiànlì le liánghǎo de zhìdù, ràng yuángōng dōu néng ānxīn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Boss He established a good system for the company, allowing employees to work with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhào Wēn lǎoshī ānpái de kèchéng, duō yuèdú, duō liànxí, nǐ de Zhōngwén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìnbù.
examples.english: As long as you follow the curriculum arranged by Teacher Wen, read more and practice more, your Chinese will make great progress.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 我是金東賢的戲迷，今天終於看到他本人，實在太開心了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Jīn Dōngxián de xìmí, jīntiān zhōngyú kàndào tā běnrén, shízài tài kāixīn le.
examples.english: I am a fan of Kim Dong-hyun; today I finally saw him in person, and I am really so happy.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi yǒu xìngfú de shēnghuó, měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: Everyone hopes their children will have a happy life and a beautiful future.

examples.chinese: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.
examples.english: When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?
examples.english: His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
examples.pinyin: Mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān, nǐ huì zhǎodào xīnzhōng zuì lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, xiànzài bié jí.
examples.english: On a certain day of a certain month in a certain year, you will find the most ideal marriage partner in your heart; don't rush now.

examples.chinese: 麗麗的老公在她生日那天，送了她九十九朵玫瑰花，好浪漫啊！
examples.pinyin: Lìlì de lǎogōng zài tā shēngrì nà tiān, sòng le tā jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, hǎo làngmàn a!
examples.english: Lili's husband gave her ninety-nine roses on her birthday; how romantic!

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

examples.chinese: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
examples.english: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.
examples.english: Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper.

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
